provisional_scope: For a fixed first-order language L and theory T, every formula is equivalent modulo T to a quantifier-free formula with the same free variables; this is a property schema whose exact syntactic and semantic formulation remains to be selected, not an accepted canonical proposition.

canonical_formal_target.blocker: The repository does not identify the theory, language, source theorem, equivalence convention, parameter policy, or whether the item is a definition or a theorem asserting the property for a concrete theory.

domain_and_universes: Provisional: a one-sorted first-order language, a theory in that language, formulas with arbitrary finite or named free-variable contexts, and models of the theory; all exact universe and context choices remain open.
hypotheses: the structure is a model of T, in the semantic formulation
phi and psi use the same free-variable context
conclusion: Provisional only: phi and psi have the same realization in every model of T under every assignment.

alternate_encodings.target: syntactic equivalence T proves the universal closure of phi iff psi
alternate_encodings.relationship: intended equivalent only after soundness/completeness and context transports

alternate_encodings.target: elimination of one existential quantifier from quantifier-free formulas
alternate_encodings.relationship: a common sufficient criterion requiring structural induction and Boolean closure

excluded_degenerate_cases: No concrete theory may be silently inserted. Sentences versus formulas with free variables, empty or inconsistent theories, equality, parameters/constants, empty carriers, many-sorted languages, and constructive versus classical equivalence all require explicit decisions.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; the classical logic, completeness, compactness, and choice requirements of any eventual theorem are not frozen
tcb_profile: Lean kernel, repository toolchain, and pinned mathlib expected; only interface-name elaboration is checked at intake
computation_profile: A constructive elimination procedure would require termination and correctness evidence; a semantic existence statement is noncomputable unless further data are supplied
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source identification, chosen theory, statement wording, formal encoding, toolchain, mathlib pin, or validator change; review due date remains open.
status_boundary: Self-tested planned intake only. The inventory label is not yet a stable proposition. No canonical Lean target, H0, M0, R0, accepted master state, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
